broadcast_pyobj_data: broadcast Python objects from a source rank to all other distributed ranks using torch.distributed
generate_masked_orthogonal_rank_groups: generate orthogonal distributed rank groups for tensor, pipeline, and data parallelism with a boolean mask
RankGenerator_init: initialize a RankGenerator with tp, sp, pp, cfg, dp sizes and an ordering string for distributed parallel setup
RankGenerator_get_ranks: get orthogonal rank groups for specified parallel types like tp, dp, or tp-dp from a RankGenerator instance
RankGenerator_get_mask: generate a boolean mask from an order string and token string to select parallelism types
